analysis.reasonEn: RSI has been consolidating in the neutral zone around 51 for two consecutive sessions, with MACD histogram showing continued weakness, indicating a lack of directional momentum. Trading volume is subdued at 0.36 times the 5-day average. The price remains within the $82,570.72 support and $86,429.35 resistance range. The 4-hour RSI at 46.3 suggests a potential shift towards weakness. While the weekly ADX at 33.5 indicates a strong trend, the absence of clear direction on the daily chart warrants a wait-and-see approach.
